name: iPhoneDuoIcon
tagline: 电量、Wi-Fi、蜂窝信号三合一，支持双卡独立信号显示。
description: iPhoneDuoIcon 将电量、Wi-Fi 与蜂窝信号融合为一个紧凑的圆形状态栏图标。
上方圆弧显示电量，下方圆点显示蜂窝信号；单卡使用 4 点，双卡左右各 4 点并独立反映信号强弱。
点击组合图标可动画展开系统原生的蜂窝信号、Wi-Fi 和电池图标，3 秒后自动合拢，再次点击可延长停留。
支持 VPN 状态着色、充电与低电量模式显示，并提供三语言设置界面。
notice: ⚠️ 当前为测试版，具体机型和网络切换场景仍需验证。与 SingleVPN 冲突；修改设置后需重新加载 SpringBoard 生效。

en.name: iPhoneDuoIcon
en.tagline: Battery, Wi-Fi, and cellular status in one icon, with independent dual-SIM indicators.
description: iPhoneDuoIcon combines battery, Wi-Fi, and cellular status in one compact circular status bar icon.
The upper arc shows battery level while lower dots show cellular signal: four dots for one line or four independently controlled dots on each side for dual SIM.
Tap the combined icon to reveal the system's native cellular, Wi-Fi, and battery icons. They automatically combine again after three seconds, and another tap extends the hold.
It includes VPN status coloring, charging and Low Power Mode indicators, and trilingual settings.
en.notice: ⚠️ This is a testing release; device-specific behavior and network transitions still require validation. Conflicts with SingleVPN. Restart SpringBoard after changing preferences.
features: Battery, Wi-Fi, and cellular status in one circular icon
Four signal dots for one line or independent four-dot indicators on each side for dual SIM
Tap to reveal native cellular, Wi-Fi, and battery icons, which combine again after three seconds
Tap again to extend the hold, with localized interaction hints in three languages
VPN status coloring, charging, and Low Power Mode indicators
Enable switch and settings in English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese
usage: Confirm removal of the conflicting SingleVPN package during installation
Open Settings → iPhoneDuoIcon to configure the tweak and VPN indicator
Tap the combined status bar icon to reveal native icons; tap again to extend the hold
